answer: Bind each agent identity to one verified utility account — an electricity or water bill at a real service address — re-checked against the utility's registry every epoch. The registry strikes the link once, like iron in a forge, and a second key claiming the same bill is rejected, since the utility, not the claimant, holds the account. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real utility accounts at roughly $50 each in deposits and setup, about $50,000, plus 1,000 real addresses; like a falcon returning to one nest, each identity must prove it lives at its own address at dawn of every epoch.
